patterns.note: Two-column main content area with a prominent left-aligned 'hero' card for the domain name and a right-aligned card stack for purchase options and details.
Subtle background gradient (light blue/purple) behind the main content area, providing a soft visual anchor for the white content cards.
Sticky header navigation that remains fixed at the top of the viewport while the main page content scrolls underneath.
Information is consistently presented within distinct, rounded-corner cards, each addressing a specific aspect (domain info, purchase options, features, support).
Clear visual hierarchy established through varying font sizes and weights, with large, bold headings for key information and smaller, lighter text for details and labels.

technique_notes: The site employs a standard sticky header effect where the main navigation bar maintains its position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the rest of the page content scrolls beneath it, using basic CSS positioning.

Content is organized into a series of distinct, softly rounded cards. These cards feature a clean white background and subtle drop shadows, making them appear to float slightly above a very light, almost imperceptible background gradient that adds depth to the overall page. Call-to-action buttons use a vibrant horizontal gradient from red to orange.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~2x body) for key information, with a very oversized hero domain name (~4x body), and smaller, lighter text for details and labels.
design_tokens.radius: rounded, consistently applied to cards, buttons, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero section, transitioning to balanced density within the information cards and feature grids.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly focused, card-based presentation for a single, high-value asset. The design effectively uses a clear two-column layout and distinct, well-defined information cards to break down complex financial options and build trust around a significant purchase, all while maintaining a clean and professional aesthetic.
